about: Totals observed outside the result rows (e.g. a review's run whose rows were not kept). evacplan.harness.load_recorded_observations reads this file; the leaderboard uses only observations of b2_vrptw, as B2's best observed total in the bar for beating B2, and only in the table of the same set, budget and host. An observation keyed by a host class (a virtual machine's host string without its ', vm boot <id>' session) applies in the table of every session of that class, which can only raise the bar; one keyed by a full host string applies to that host only (program/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-01). Add an entry only with a source that documents the number. Keys: set, budget_s, method, host, delivered_checked, source (required); unresolved, commit, recorded, note (optional).
